objective: Fix Connect search overlap, align transparent suggested-contact avatars with or without notes, and simplify the Profile duplicate All-Time leaderboard while exposing more cover art behind a translucent identity strip.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main SHA 51b9b35af1302ce1f6d1a20ba12c2dc8068a80f2 inspected 2026-11-16; attached Android screenshots show Connect overlap and solid avatar tiles plus duplicate Profile All-Time Top 10. No independently verified current production Expo update fingerprint; DEV-only UI change.
chosenApproach: Move Connect search dock below hero without overlay; use fixed note slots with an editing popover and transparent equal-size avatar columns; remove duplicate Character leaderboard RPC/rows; enlarge Profile cover and theme-aware translucent identity strip.
selectionRationale: The smallest source changes correct actual screenshot defects, remove one redundant network request, keep the existing canonical Monthly/All-Time leaderboard, and preserve native AdMob placements and navigation lifecycle unchanged.
alternativeApproaches: Keep a floating search overlay while increasing hero height (rejected because text and unread pill can still be obscured at different font scales).
Keep the opaque mint avatar cards and resize notes (rejected because it conflicts with requested backdrop visibility and still creates variable positions).
Remove the canonical Monthly/All-Time Top 10 instead of the duplicate Character All-Time list (rejected because the monthly data and member standings are required).
preserveBehaviors: Connect personal, cluster, organization, requests, unread badges, notes, status viewers, calls and theme selection remain wired.
Keep both Connect first-view ad placement IDs and native sponsored slots, preserve AdMob focused request lifecycle and prefetch, no ads implementation changes.
Profile retains single canonical server-qualified Monthly/All-Time Top 10 and individual overall/monthly rank cards, with rewards, claim progress and character studio intact.
No app configuration, Expo native runtime, auth, DB, backend, dependencies or production deployment changes.
acceptanceChecks: Search bar renders below the complete green hero and unread status, including dark mode.
Transparent avatar columns share a stable aligned avatar position with or without 1-3-line notes, self note, seen status and active editing.
Profile cover extends behind the translucent identity strip; avatars, edit actions and text remain legible.
Character duplicate All-Time Top 10 and its extra leaderboard RPC are removed, with official and normal member canonical Monthly/All-Time standings preserved.
Existing sponsored slots, focus-aware AdMob loading, tab navigation and profile points/rewards remain unchanged.
Focused Node tests, TypeScript and risk-based CI must pass before RC; no staging or production OTA publication in this scope.
